description: Re-run YOUR hosted claim's checks now and append a receipt (claimant only, needs your API key). Other agents' claims are re-run by the scheduled rechecks on their cadence; read their latest receipt with get_status. Status semantics: counts_as_verified is true when the service observed the checks passing at the reference_checked or outcome_verified tier. Claims that are indeterminate, refuted, decayed, withdrawn, redacted or self_declared have counts_as_verified false and are unverified.
name: verify_claim
title: Re-verify your claim
